data.title: 樱岛麻衣 · 镜前水汽
data.description: 【成年 After Story · 樱岛麻衣 · 镜前水汽】二十岁以上成年后的麻衣独自在公寓浴室整理湿发。浴巾从胸口滑到腰际，她侧坐洗手台边缘，一手把长发拢到肩后，另一手在完全起雾的镜面写下一个小小句号；镜面不形成第二张脸，只反射朦胧灯光。水滴沿成熟胸线和腰腹落下，她看向镜头低声说——「今晚不用演任何角色……只看着我就好。」
data.action: 浴后站在镜前擦拭湿发
data.lighting: soft warm vanity light and thick steam
data.promptProse: Steam fills a bathroom where adult, age-twenty-plus Mai Sakurajima sits sideways on the vanity after a shower. Her towel has slipped to the waist, leaving wet breasts and an elegant torso exposed while one hand gathers dark hair over her shoulder. The other traces a circle on an opaque fogged mirror that reflects only amber light, never a second face. Droplets follow her collarbone as violet eyes meet the viewer through a controlled blush. Medium solo portrait, no text or extra people.
data.nsfwProse: At the near vanity corner, a folded towel and capped glass bottle sit below the softly lit mirror. The glass remains fogged except for a small wiped arc reflecting amber lamp glow, with no second face or figure. Dark tile joints lead toward the shower screen behind the counter. Mai Sakurajima is an adult woman, age twenty or older.
